# X22-autocompact-limit: a read-only turn with a low automatic compaction limit (-c model_auto_compact_token_limit=20000 before app-server): three commands print about 1500 rows each, the context passes the limit, and Codex compacts in the middle of the turn (a contextCompaction item, a usage total whose `last` is the context after compaction), then answers.
# Recorded with codex-cli 0.160.1 (a ChatGPT login, the Windows sandbox ready); the published fixture is synthesized from that recording (scripts/synthesize-fixtures.mjs), which stays private.
# The model is pinned as Dim Factory sends a picked one (gpt-6-luna). The first attempt (one summarising script, about 13.7k tokens of context) never reached the limit and was discarded; the prompt now asks for each command as written.
# --allow-user-codex-home only when <CODEX_HOME> is your own ~/.codex.
# A fresh git-init copy of tests/fixtures/sandboxes/ts-small as <sandbox>.
node scripts/record-fixture.mjs --codex-app-server --bin "<codex.exe>" --codex-home "<CODEX_HOME>" --allow-user-codex-home --cwd "<sandbox>" --out tests/fixtures-private/codex/app-server/X22-autocompact-limit --id X22 --slug autocompact-limit --cli-version <x.y.z> --timing off --timeout 900000 --stdin tests/fixtures/codex/recipes/X22-autocompact-limit/stdin.jsonl --pass-file tests/fixtures/codex/recipes/X22-autocompact-limit/pass.json -- -c model_auto_compact_token_limit=20000 app-server --listen stdio://
